component.name: SSH Manager
component.summary: Organise SSH hosts, open terminals, transfer files and connect to remote desktops

description.p: SSH Manager keeps SSH, SFTP, FTP/FTPS and RDP hosts in groups, opens SSH sessions in built-in terminals, transfers files in a two-pane browser and shows Windows desktops through FreeRDP. Passwords are kept in an encrypted store or the desktop keyring, never in plain files.
